3a4aa859ea72034dfb65805941fac372

Verifikasi via Terminal

SHA256 (disarankan)

echo "f875c9a605bfe6a8425d1d353a3c1ec755bf37f5b0a3231ca19e2145da0ff450 *deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso" | shasum -a 256 --check

MD5

echo "3a4aa859ea72034dfb65805941fac372 *deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso" | md5sum --check
Output yang benar: deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso: OK

✅ OK = file asli, aman digunakan  |  ❌ FAILED = file rusak, download ulang

Perintah alternatif (Linux / Windows / macOS)

Jalankan lalu bandingkan output hash-nya — harus sama persis.

sha256sum deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso
md5sum deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso
Get-FileHash .\deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso -Algorithm SHA256
Get-FileHash .\deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso -Algorithm MD5
shasum -a 256 deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso
md5 deepin-desktop-community-25.2.0-amd64.iso
